question: What does the idiom 'Barking up the wrong tree' mean?
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3** i.e. Accusing wrongly.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"Barking up the wrong tree"** means to pursue a mistaken or misguided course of action, particularly in accusing someone or something wrongly. (गलत दिशा में प्रयास करना या गलत आरोप लगाना)

 
 
• **Example:** The detective was barking up the wrong tree by suspecting the wrong person in the case.
 
 
 
• **"Accusing wrongly"** refers to blaming someone for something they did not do or making a false accusation. (गलत तरीके से आरोप लगाना)
 
 
• **Example:** She accused him wrongly of stealing her phone, but later found it in her bag.
 
 
 
• Hence, the idiom "Barking up the wrong tree" means accusing wrongly, making option 3 the correct answer.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Apologizing** (माफी मांगना): Expressing regret or saying sorry for wrongdoing.

 
 
• **Example:** He apologized for arriving late to the meeting.
 
 
 
• **Praising someone** (किसी की प्रशंसा करना): Expressing admiration or approval for someone’s qualities or actions.
 
 
• **Example:** The teacher praised the student for her excellent performance in class.
 
 
 
• **Succeeding quickly** (जल्दी सफलता प्राप्त करना): Achieving a goal or accomplishment in a short period of time.
 
 
• **Example:** He succeeded quickly in his new job due to his hard work and dedication.
